bull.b: FDA alignment on a potential registrational path reduces regulatory uncertainty around REO 033 and creates a clearer development route. If clinical results are supportive, the defined endpoints could help the company advance pelareorep toward approval more efficiently.

The randomized REO 033 program is moving beyond early exploratory work toward controlled evidence in a difficult-to-treat colorectal cancer population. Site activation, enrollment, and planned expansion could strengthen the lead asset’s clinical validation over the next several quarters.

Progress across multiple gastrointestinal cancer cohorts supports pelareorep’s potential as a combination therapy platform rather than a single-indication asset. Meeting predefined efficacy criteria and completing enrollment provide a broader clinical foundation for future development decisions.

bear.b: Without commercial product revenue, Oncolytics has not yet established a self-funding business model and remains dependent on clinical progress to create future economic value. The absence of sales also leaves operating performance vulnerable to development setbacks and financing requirements.

Sustained negative cash flow means the company is consuming capital to fund operations and clinical programs rather than generating internal liquidity. Continued burn increases the importance of external financing or partnerships and can constrain the pace and flexibility of development.

Negative equity and a substantial reduction in assets indicate weakened financial flexibility compared with prior years. This balance-sheet deterioration may make it harder to absorb delays, sustain research spending, or pursue development plans without additional capital.
